newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-May industrial product sales rate 94 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-May industrial product sales rate 94 pct.

text.p: China's sales rate of industrial products in the January-May period stood at 94.39 percent, the Financial News said on Monday.
The figure was 0.73 percentage points higher compared with the year-ago period, it said.
The rate of sales to production for May alone was 94.99 percent, up 0.31 percentage points compared with the year-ago period, the newspaper said.
